# Working and contribution rules

Fictional project · Reference practice 0.4.0

## A request is not yet accepted

New books must fit the corpus profile and be freely reusable. Source, context and rights conditions are mentioned. A short preliminary request clarifies scope and available review capacity.

## Applicable contribution

The article names data and tool stand, stable IDs, conversion and technical tests. Uncertain limits or solutions are documented. The editorial board decides on recording and approval.

## Accesses and work history

Personal accounts receive appropriate rights. No access data, private communications or unexplained third-party materials are included in Git. Public history is consciously released; branches are not a confidentiality limit.

## Limited commitments

Error reports, audited contributions and independent compatible subcorpora are different forms of participation. The care commitment and responsibility are visible; out of openness there is no unlimited obligation to integrate.
